title: Mossling
body:
I was bored and decided to make a mossy Ghastling! Why not?

![Cute!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81925ae4681eaa9c27e43b6e83b18ee953c82304.jpeg)

Cute!

![Soft!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d261de5a6a8d50642fa5297a4c6127c9f88a751.jpeg)

Soft!

![:3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd0b4969a007e874c2c7d0acddd3a176c487902d.png)

And it also smells like fresh moss and grass.
